[[Racing Beetle]]s are [[charmable animal]]s encountered in the [[Zaishen Menagerie]].

==Locations==
*[[Core]]
**[[The Battle Isles]]
***{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)

==Skills==
*[[File:Rollerbeetle Racer.jpg|25px|link=Rolling Start]] [[Rolling Start]]

==Acquisition==
* [[Kenichi]] will unlock this charmable animal in exchange for 100 [[Racing Medal]]s which can be obtained through [[Rollerbeetle Racing]] (only available during [[Shing Jea Boardwalk]] events)
* [[Zaishen Menagerie Grounds/Service costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zgold}} plus 100{{gold}} or 10,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Prestige, Exotic)''

==Notes==
* Racing Beetles deal [[slashing damage]].
* A [[character]]'s [[Rollerbeetle Racer]] and their Racing Beetle have the same design, which is changed by talking to [[Hokusai]]. The color changes randomly each time an [[instance]] is entered; there's no way to fix it.
*On the Menagerie grounds, the adult Racing Beetles have a different color and pattern each time the instance is loaded, but the juveniles always look like plain [[Rock Beetle]]s.
{{anomaly|
* Racing Beetles [[Attack speed|attack faster]] than other pets (1.33 versus 2). However, they move at the same speed as players - other pets move 25% faster.
* The color of the beetle in the instance doesn't match the color in its portrait on the [[Pet Commander]].}}

== Trivia ==
* Introduced in [[Canthan New Year 2013]].
* This is the only pet that utilizes a [[disguise]].
